description: TPL Life Insurance Limited is a Pakistani life and health insurer and a subsidiary of TPL Corp, the listed TPL group holding company. It describes itself as an insurtech, selling life and health cover through digital channels and partner ecosystems rather than a traditional agency force, with the aim of making health and life insurance accessible and affordable. It has been writing life and health business for over a decade.
